ideas.pitch: An embedded firmware package for ESP32 and Arduino that detects the transition from line tracking (Zone A) to maze solving (Zone B) using optical sensor fusion and instant state-switching.
ideas.problem_statement: Zone A Line Tracking followed by Zone B Maze Solving in one continuous run without human intervention.
ideas.title: HybridSwitch: Seamless Zone Transition Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates robust real-time state machine switching between PID line tracking and flood-fill maze solving, targeting the core technical bottleneck of the hybrid challenge.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-software co-designed mouse featuring infrared proximity arrays and an optimized C-based flood-fill algorithm that memorizes maze layouts for high-speed secondary runs.
ideas.problem_statement: Navigate a walled maze with no guiding line, retain map information, and execute faster subsequent runs to achieve the lowest final score.
ideas.title: FloodFill-X: Adaptive Maze Mapping Micro-Mouse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages unusual physical build mechanics and an efficient pathfinding algorithm directly tied to the scoring metric of lowest final time plus penalties.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and line-detection overlay module that identifies checkpoint markers on the 3 cm black line, allowing instant autonomous recovery and error-free restarts.
ideas.problem_statement: Zone A Line Tracking involving 3 cm-wide black lines on a white floor with checkpoint markers used for restarts.
ideas.title: CheckpointGuard: Autonomous Restart & Recovery Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Minimizes time penalties from human intervention during restarts by automating checkpoint localization via onboard sensors.

ideas.pitch: A custom-routed PCB and embedded driver suite combining QTR line sensors and VL53L0X time-of-flight distance sensors into a single unified navigation stream.
ideas.problem_statement: An autonomous robot capable of completing two navigation challenges (line tracking and maze solving) in one continuous run.
ideas.title: DualNav: Unified Sensor Fusion Board for Hybrid Tracks
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases exceptionally clean hardware integration and custom sensor layout, standing out among standard kit builds in a robotics competition.

ideas.pitch: An ESP-NOW wireless telemetry bridge that streams sensor states, battery levels, and run-timer penalties to a sideline dashboard for real-time debugging.
ideas.problem_statement: The winner is determined by the lowest final score, calculated as run time plus applicable penalties.
ideas.title: MicroTelemetry: Live Run Diagnostics and Scoring Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides judges with an immediate, transparent view of robot performance metrics and penalty breakdowns during live runs.
